description: This file defines the NewtonsoftJsonCodec class which implements serialization, deserialization, and copying of objects using JSON via Newtonsoft.Json library. It is used within the Orleans serialization framework to handle JSON-based serialization for specific types, with support for custom type filtering and options.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec
classes.description: A codec for serializing, deserializing, and copying objects using JSON with Newtonsoft.Json within the Orleans serialization system. Supports type filtering and options customization.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the codec with type selectors and options.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an object field into the written stream using JSON.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON value into an object of the expected type.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a type is supported for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object using JSON serialization.

methods.name: IsSupportedType (private static)
methods.description: Checks if a type is natively supported by Json.NET.

methods.name: ThrowTypeFieldMissing
methods.description: Throws an exception if the serialized type information is missing.

methods.name: IsSupportedType (private)
methods.description: Checks support for a type considering both codec and copier support.
